[];\n        if (slots.length === 0) {\n            return html`<div class=\"message\">No codes reported</div>`;\n        }\n\n        const groups = this._groupSlots(slots);\n        const borrowedSlots = this._identifyBorrowedSlots(groups);\n        const result = this._renderGroupsWithBorrowing(groups, borrowedSlots);\n        return html`<div class=\"slots-grid\">${result}</div>`;\n    }\n\n    /** Find empty-group slots to \"borrow\" so lone active slots get a grid partner. */\n    private _identifyBorrowedSlots(groups: SlotGroup[]): Set<number | string> {\n        const borrowed = new Set<number | string>();\n        for (let i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {\n            const group = groups[i];\n            if (group.type !== 'active' || group.slots.length !== 1) continue;\n\n            const [slot] = group.slots;\n            const slotNum = typeof slot.slot === 'string' ? parseInt(slot.slot, 10) : slot.slot;\n            const isOdd = slotNum % 2 === 1;\n            const prevGroup = i > 0 ? groups[i - 1] : null;\n            const nextGroup = i < groups.length - 1 ? groups[i + 1] : null;\n\n            if (isOdd && nextGroup?.type === 'empty' && nextGroup.slots.length > 0) {\n                borrowed.add(nextGroup.slots[0].slot);\n            } else if (!isOdd && prevGroup?.type === 'empty' && prevGroup.slots.length > 0) {\n                borrowed.add(prevGroup.slots[prevGroup.slots.length - 1].slot);\n            }\n        }\n        return borrowed;\n    }\n\n    /** Render slot groups, pairing lone active slots with borrowed empty neighbors. */\n    private _renderGroupsWithBorrowing(\n        groups: SlotGroup[],\n        borrowedSlots: Set<number | string>\n    ): TemplateResult[] {\n        const result: TemplateResult[] = [];\n        for (let i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {\n            const group = groups[i];\n            const prevGroup = i > 0 ? groups[i - 1] : null;\n            const nextGroup = i < groups.length - 1 ? groups[i + 1] : null;\n\n            if (group.type === 'active') {\n                if (group.slots.length === 1) {\n                    const [slot] = group.slots;\n                    const slotNum =\n                        typeof slot.slot === 'string' ? parseInt(slot.slot, 10) : slot.slot;\n                    const isOdd = slotNum % 2 === 1;\n\n                    if (isOdd && nextGroup?.type === 'empty' && nextGroup.slots.length > 0) {\n                        result.push(this._renderSlotChip(slot, false));\n                        result.push(this._renderEmptySlotChip(nextGroup.slots[0]));\n                    } else if (\n                        !isOdd &&\n                        prevGroup?.type === 'empty' &&\n                        prevGroup.slots.length > 0\n                    ) {\n                        result.push(\n                            this._renderEmptySlotChip(prevGroup.slots[prevGroup.slots.length - 1])\n                        );\n                        result.push(this._renderSlotChip(slot, false));\n                    } else {\n                        result.push(this._renderSlotChip(slot, true));\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    for (const slot of group.slots) {\n                        result.push(this._renderSlotChip(slot, false));\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                const remainingSlots = group.slots.filter((s) => !borrowedSlots.has(s.slot));\n                if (remainingSlots.length > 0) {\n                    result.push(\n                        this._renderEmptySummary({\n                            ...group,\n                            rangeLabel: this._formatSlotRange(remainingSlots),\n                            slots: remainingSlots\n                        })\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }"
```json
}
```

```
92	        const handler = routes[msg.type];
93	        if (handler) {
94	            return handler(msg);
95	        }
96	        throw new Error(`Unexpected callWS type: ${msg.type}`);
97	    };
```

```json
  "description": "Find exactly which changed lines are uncovered"
}
```

- **Python**: gated test-results upload to target Python version only (`matrix.python-version == needs.setup.outputs.target-python`) to avoid duplicate Test Analytics entries

> DEVELOPER

are we good with human redable output for python?

> AGENT

Yes — pytest keeps its default console output regardless of `--junitxml`. The `--junitxml` flag only adds a file output; it doesn't replace the terminal reporter like vitest's `--reporter` does. So no change needed on the Python side.

```
599	    private _getCodeClass(slot: LockCoordinatorSlotData): string {
600	        const mode = this._config?.code_display ?? DEFAULT_CODE_DISPLAY;
601	        const shouldMask = mode === 'masked' || (mode === 'masked_with_reveal' && !this._revealed);
602	
603	        // Active code on the lock
604	        if (isSlotEmpty(slot.code) && !slot.code_length) return 'no-code';
605	        if (slot.code === SLOT_CODE_UNKNOWN || slot.code_length) return 'masked';
606	        if (slot.code !== null && slot.code !== '') return '';
607	
608	        // No active code - check for configured code (disabled LCM slot)
609	        if (slot.configured_code) {
610	            // We have the actual code - choose class based on display mode
611	            return shouldMask ? 'disabled masked' : 'disabled';
612	        }
613	        if (slot.configured_code_length) {
614	            // Only have length (always masked)
615	            return 'disabled masked';
616	        }
617	
618	        return 'no-code';
619	    }

621	    private _formatCode(slot: LockCoordinatorSlotData): string {
622	        const mode = this._config?.code_display ?? DEFAULT_CODE_DISPLAY;
623	        const shouldMask = mode === 'masked' || (mode === 'masked_with_reveal' && !this._revealed);
624	
625	        // Active code on the lock
626	        if (slot.code === SLOT_CODE_UNKNOWN) return '• • •';
627	        if (isSlotEmpty(slot.code)) {
628	            if (slot.code_length) return '•'.repeat(slot.code_length);
629	            // Fall through to configured code or dash below
630	        } else if (slot.code !== null) {
631	            return shouldMask ? '•'.repeat(String(slot.code).length) : String(slot.code);
632	        }
633	
634	        // Disabled LCM slot: show configured code (respect masking)
635	        if (slot.configured_code) {
636	            return shouldMask ? '•'.repeat(slot.configured_code.length) : slot.configured_code;
637	        }
638	        if (slot.configured_code_length) {
639	            return '•'.repeat(slot.configured_code_length);
640	        }
641	
642	        return '—';
643	    }
```

```
167	    // Editing methods for unmanaged slots
168	    private _startEditing(e: Event, slot: LockCoordinatorSlotData): void {
169	        e.stopPropagation();
170	        // Save current reveal state before editing
171	        this._wasRevealedBeforeEdit = this._revealed;
172	        // For editing, we need the actual code - trigger reveal if masked
173	        if (!this._revealed) {
174	            this._revealed = true;
175	            this._unsubscribe();
176	            void this._subscribe();
177	        }
178	        // Get the current code value (if any); sentinels are not editable values
179	        const currentCode =
180	            isSlotOccupied(slot.code) && slot.code !== SLOT_CODE_UNKNOWN ? String(slot.code) : '';
181	        this._editValue = currentCode;
182	        this._editingSlot = slot.slot;
183	        // Focus input after render
184	        this.updateComplete.then(() => {
185	            const input = this.shadowRoot?.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('.slot-code-input');
186	            input?.focus();
187	            input?.select();
188	        });
189	    }
190	
191	    private _handleEditInput(e: Event): void {
192	        const input = e.target as HTMLInputElement;
193	        this._editValue = input.value;
194	    }
195	
196	    private _handleEditKeydown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
197	        if (e.key === 'Enter' && this._editingSlot !== null) {
198	            void this._saveCode(this._editingSlot);
199	        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
200	            this._cancelEdit();
201	        }
202	    }
203	
204	    private _cancelEdit(): void {
205	        this._editingSlot = null;
206	        this._editValue = '';
207	        // Restore reveal state if it was changed for editing
208	        if (this._revealed !== this._wasRevealedBeforeEdit) {
209	            this._revealed = this._wasRevealedBeforeEdit;
210	            this._unsubscribe();
211	            void this._subscribe();
212	        }
213	    }
```

```
[Copilot] ts/lock-codes-card.ts:601
`_getCodeClass` now ignores `configured_code` / `configured_code_length`. For slots where the lock has no active code (`code` is null/''/'empty' and no `code_length`) but LCM has a configured PIN, this function will return `'no-code'`, which applies the placeholder styling even though `_formatCode` will display the configured PIN. Consider treating configured PIN slots as disabled/inactive (e.g., return `'disabled'` / `'disabled masked'` based on display mode, or at least avoid `'no-code'` when 

[Copilot] ts/slot-card.integration.test.ts:1643
The `_formatScheduleDate` tests rely on the real current time (`new Date()`), which can make them flaky around midnight / timezone boundaries (e.g., “today” vs “tomorrow”). Consider using `vi.useFakeTimers()` + `vi.setSystemTime(...)` to pin “now” to a fixed timestamp for these assertions, and restoring timers afterward.
```

```json
  "new_string": "    private _getCodeClass(slot: LockCoordinatorSlotData): string {\n        const mode = this._config?.code_display ?? DEFAULT_CODE_DISPLAY;\n        const shouldMask = mode === 'masked' || (mode === 'masked_with_reveal' && !this._revealed);\n\n        if (slot.code === SLOT_CODE_UNKNOWN || slot.code_length) return 'masked';\n        if (!isSlotEmpty(slot.code)) return '';\n\n        // Empty/null code on the lock — check for a configured PIN\n        // (disabled LCM slot where the code hasn't been pushed yet).\n        if (slot.configured_code) {\n            return shouldMask ? 'disabled masked' : 'disabled';\n        }\n        if (slot.configured_code_length) {\n            return 'disabled masked';\n        }\n        return 'no-code';\n    }"
}
```

Pushed `50ef9fa`. Both review comments addressed:

1. **`_getCodeClass` configured_code**: not dead code — it was unreachable due to a check-ordering bug. Restructured so `isSlotEmpty()` check comes AFTER unknown/code_length, allowing fall-through to configured_code for disabled LCM slots. Tests restored with correct assertions.

2. **`_formatScheduleDate` flakiness**: pinned to `2026-03-18T12:00:00` via `vi.useFakeTimers()` after element setup completes (so `flush()`'s setTimeout isn't blocked).

Note: `_formatLockCode`'s `codeLength` branch in slot-card.ts remains pruned — that one IS genuinely dead (same `isSlotEmpty` early-return pattern, and `LockSyncStatus.code` is `string | null` so there's no non-empty value that skips the `code !== null && code !== ''` check).
